tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: x402_parse_payment_request
tools.description: Free. Decode one x402 v2 payment request (base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, PaymentRequired JSON or MCP tool result) and list every accepts option with exact atomic and decimal amounts. Token addresses are compared with a limited reference list. status: parsed, ambiguous (options differ in recipient,

tools.name: x402_known_assets
tools.description: Free. The limited reference list this server compares token addresses with: known assets (network, contract, symbol, decimals) with sources and check dates, known CAIP-2 networks, scheme names from the x402 specs, and payment flows. A table match is not proof that an asset or a merchant is genuine.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
